summary.scope: Publish the fixed-pad U body axis and closed rigid-continuation/fine-factorization failures.

fixed_pad_U_body_axis.scope: Reconstruct nonlinear U equilibrium and compare objective fields across resolved contact meshes.
fixed_pad_U_body_axis.limitations: Every retained accepted-step residual record is checked; only final complete fields were saved. Independent nonlinear bulk equilibrium is reconstructed with the retained final nodal contact forces, not a missing friction history. Proper finite frames and direct P2 deformation-gradient evaluation at common material points avoid stress interpolation and infinitesimal-rotation assumptions. The declared axis and semantic geometry hashes distinguish coupled, fixed-body pad and fixed-pad body studies. Body CAD/volume and pad geometry/volume/contact resolution still require their own separated checks. Probe norms are diagnostics rather than continuum integrals; two levels cannot establish a tail. Discrete masses are recorded without density retuning. Full history/contact reconstruction, separated axes, refined contact references, native finite footprints, actual Franka, feedback and verified warmed accuracy/cost remain separate requirements.

limitations: All865 retained original rigid states pass separate physical force/moment/robot/motion audits. Step866 direct and residual-continuation recovery failures remain rejected; numerical stages add zero physical states. The171228-tet factorization MemoryError yields no accepted initializer or dynamic state. Three U body/geometry approximations share byte-identical pad geometry/material/actuation, but represented body mass changes at fixed density. Last-pair tensor12.33%, energy0.962% and raw lower peak5.26% do not establish physical convergence. Raw fields, original budgets and all failed records remain intact; full physical/model/feedback/warmed-cost scope stays open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
